scope: Packaged macOS startup continues when notification identity initialization fails, notification delivery remains unavailable until identity initialization succeeds, macOS windows cannot bypass that gate through plugin notify/show commands, and the fictional packaged harness registers and resolves only its sealed application bundle before launch.

historicalFailure.failure: notify_rust::set_application failure propagated from Tauri setup and the packaged process aborted with SIGABRT before UI acceptance

behavior: The notification identity initializer is nonfallible at the Tauri setup boundary and reports failure without returning an error from setup.
The macOS notification command refuses delivery before constructing or showing notification content unless the managed identity state is available.
Missing managed readiness state fails closed with the same unavailable result.
Main and Settings may inspect and request notification permission on macOS, but plugin notify and show permissions are absent.
Settings uses the same identity-gated application command as new-mail notifications.
Linux and Windows retain their platform-scoped notification plugin capability.
The native harness registers the exact sealed fictional application with LaunchServices and requires the bundle identifier to resolve to that exact canonical path before direct execution.

checks.environmentNote: The first sandboxed attempt passed 191 and failed 19 because the sandbox denied every affected loopback listener bind with EPERM. The identical full suite passed outside the sandbox, where its isolated fictional IMAP, SMTP, translation, updater and ACL listeners could bind.

checks.command: read-only Swift LaunchServices helper compile and nonexistent-bundle query with an exclusive private module cache
checks.sideEffects: No application registration or launch was performed.

limitations: No packaged application was launched after this repair, so LaunchServices registration, startup continuation and notification identity still require the controlled native replay.

The source and harness checks do not establish Developer ID signing, notarization, stapling, updater signing or publication.
The initial sandboxed full feature attempt is retained as an environment failure, not a flaky product-test failure or a pass.
